2026_01_NYJ_TEN.headline: New York’s depleted depth meets a Tennessee defense missing its tackling anchor
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.paragraph1: The Jets enter Tennessee without Kene Nwangwu, Tim Patrick and Joseph Ossai, with cornerback D'Angelo Ponds doubtful, while the Titans will be without linebacker Cedric Gray after a concussion. Those absences create pressure on both teams’ depth before either offense has established a regular-season identity. New York needs to avoid exposing a thinner roster to long, high-volume drives, and Tennessee must replace Gray’s tackling production cleanly. Field position, run defense and third-down execution should matter more than early-game fireworks in this opener.
2026_01_NYJ_TEN.model_rationale: New York can gain control by staying ahead of the chains and protecting its thinner depth, while Tennessee needs clean linebacker replacements and sustained drives to create pressure over four quarters.
